issues: fig-02-11: replace caption with: Contour plot of $\mathcal{L} = 	frac12(	heta_1^2 + 25	heta_2^2)$ ($\kappa = 25$, for legibility) over $	heta_1 \in [-2, 0.5]$, $	heta_2 \in [-0.5, 0.5]$, with two 40-step paths from $(-1.8, 0.35)$, a dot per step and the minimum marked. Gradient descent at $\eta = 0.07$ multiplies $	heta_2$ by $-0.75$ each step, so it zig-zags across the valley and crawls along it. Heavy ball at $\eta = 0.015$, $\mu = 0.9$ (the same effective rate scale, $\eta/(1-\mu) = 0.15$) moves smoothly, overshoots along the valley and spirals in. (Reason: heavy ball at eta = 0.07, mu = 0.9 does not move smoothly. Its theta_2 roots have modulus 0.95, a decay slower than gradient descent's 0.75, with a large rotation angle per step, so the path zig-zags chaotically and theta_1 overshoots to 0.98, outside the stated range. The figure is drawn at eta = 0.015, where theta_1 peaks at 0.42.)

fig-02-10: seed 0 reproduces the worked-example table (He 1.42/1.39/1.46/1.43, tanh N(0,1) 87% saturated) exactly except ReLU PyTorch default (0.582/0.233/0.041/0.041 against 0.579/0.246/0.0435/0.0402); not visible on the log axis. ReLU + N(0, 0.01^2) leaves the plotted range after layer 10 (below 1e-10).
fig-02-9: minima (-0.752, -0.170) and (-1.278, -0.278) computed by optimisation and match the caption; leaky ReLU main panel is drawn at a = 0.01 with the a = 0.1 inset as the caption says.
